layers.name: Depth axis

entities.name: Relational quantum events
entities.summary: The single primitive. Spacetime, fields, and every object above are coarse statistics of a locally finite partial order of these discrete events, each carrying an amplitude relative to a frame.

entities.name: The IR boundary
entities.summary: What classical cosmology calls the Big Bang: not the start of everything but the IR edge of one universe's chart — a T⁻ left-approach to a seam, read from inside.

entities.name: The early beat
entities.summary: Cosmic inflation, re-read: P4 firing fast as a new chart nucleates near its IR edge. The fastest becoming a universe undergoes; it lays the seed statistics of all later structure.

entities.name: Sequence knots
entities.summary: Stars — the calmest, longest-lived knots of the event-lattice. Fusion is real and also the surface signature of a stable RQE knot far from any limit. The reference state of the sky.

entities.name: Correlation islands
entities.summary: Galaxies — regions where mutual information is dense enough to bind matter into a statistic. Type is classical morphology; substance is the same information field that forms the tower.

entities.name: The lattice web
entities.summary: The cosmic web — filaments, walls, voids — is the OCT lattice of this universe seen edge-on. Look at the web and you are looking at the bottom rungs of the tower.

entities.name: Field veils
entities.summary: Nebulae — the structured vacuum made briefly legible. Pilots read bright veils as free charts of the medium they would otherwise navigate blind.

entities.name: Ember & beacon cores
entities.summary: White dwarfs, neutron stars, pulsars — dense knots, the substrate packed but far from tearing. Beacon cores keep relational time so cleanly that fleets anchor ΛL phase to them.

entities.name: Information reefs
entities.summary: Shoals of dense mutual information where causal order frays and signals arrive out of sequence. Prized as natural archives, feared as places a ship entangles with its own past track.

entities.name: Depth-wells
entities.summary: A region where the effective Planck length locally shortens — a rung of the tower breaking surface. How Class I ships punch above their rated speed, and how they are lost when it closes.

entities.name: Core fall
entities.summary: Core-collapse supernovae — the old universe driving a region toward the seam unaided. Every core fall is a natural experiment in seam-approach, birthing a seam-well and flushing the rest as light.

entities.name: Entropic horizons
entities.summary: Where horizon thermodynamics dominates — the regime classical entropic-gravity theories mistook for bedrock. In QTR the Bekenstein bound here is one of the three quantities that diverges at 𝔍.

entities.name: Natural seam-wells
entities.summary: Black holes — the classical sky's only natural approach to the seam. The horizon is exactly where field language fails. Via ER=EPR, every seam-well is a potential unlit mouth of a Penrose bridge.

entities.name: Seam-pearls
entities.summary: A small region held permanently at ΛL value T• — simultaneously here and elsewhere. The closest thing to a naturally occurring open door: it neither collapses nor opens fully, and hums at the crossing forever.

entities.name: The crossing
entities.summary: The native seam event: the approach (T⁻) drives density up; phase-lock (T•) opens the Idrenes Bridge and the ship is here-and-there at once; Resurrection collapses it to a definite "there." The whole basis of FTL.

entities.name: Seam-scars
entities.summary: The healed-over wake of a past crossing — a region where the effective description is subtly wrong. A hazard to instruments and an archaeological record of who crossed here before.

entities.name: Refusal zones
entities.summary: Where geometry begins to refuse to close — parallels diverge, conservation leaks, the ΛL value of "this obeys our laws" drifts T → F. Not an object but a symptom: the substrate's laws beginning to disagree with themselves.

entities.name: Law-shards
entities.summary: Fragments where a region has re-solved into a different lawset — a patch of this universe running on foreign rules. The only physical evidence that constitution-travel is real, and the only place the Κ5 verdicts might be tested.

entities.name: The curvature limit Κ
entities.summary: The maximum curvature the substrate's laws can sustain. Not a speed you exceed — a tolerance you violate. Cross it and the region re-solves into different laws. Globally unmeasurable; known only by refusal zones.

entities.name: The Formless mouths
entities.summary: Rumoured apertures where Κ and the transfinite tower touch — through which the Madman's Theorem claims a ship could pass intact and return. The Assembly denies they exist. The grail of the whole Κ5 controversy.

entities.name: Bridge-mouths
entities.summary: The paired termini of a Penrose bridge: a black hole (ingoing) in one universe, a white hole (ejecting) in a same-level neighbour. Held open by a squeezed sub-vacuum. One-way per throat — born out, never fallen back.

entities.name: Same-level neighbour
entities.summary: Another universe at the same OCT depth, joined to this one by entanglement. Reached by bridge-transit, not by diving. It has its own sky, its own seam — but the same laws, being the same depth.

entities.name: Sequence knots
entities.summary: Main-sequence stars — the calmest, longest-lived knots of the event-lattice.
entities.reading: A star is a self-sustaining region of moderate event density where the effective description holds perfectly — fusion is real, and it is also the surface signature of a stable RQE knot that neither strains toward the seam nor dissipates. The Sun is a textbook sequence knot: utterly classical, utterly far from 𝔍.
entities.note: The reference state of the object catalogue — the "calm vacuum" of stellar physics.

entities.name: Swollen knots
entities.summary: Giants and supergiants — knots whose effective envelope has expanded late in life.
entities.reading: The same substrate knot, its effective envelope inflated as the core reorganizes. Nothing new at the substrate level — a swollen knot is a sequence knot in a later phase of its own coarse statistics. Included so the catalogue stays complete against the old sky.
entities.note: Purely classical. QTR adds no reinterpretation beyond scale.

entities.name: Rhythm stars
entities.summary: Variable stars — a knot whose pulsation makes the P4 growth-beat briefly visible.
entities.real_anchor: Pulsating, eruptive and cataclysmic variables (Cepheids, RR Lyrae).
entities.reading: A variable star is the one place the substrate's becoming rule (P4) surfaces to the naked eye. The regular pulse of a Cepheid is a classical oscillation — and also the closest a calm star comes to showing you the beat of event-growth underneath. Pilots historically used rhythm stars to calibrate P4 phase.
entities.note: The first faint bridge from classical astronomy to substrate physics.

entities.name: Ember cores
entities.summary: White dwarfs and neutron stars — dense knots, the substrate packed but far from tearing.
entities.reading: The dense end of the effective layer: event density high enough that quantum degeneracy dominates, yet nowhere near Κ. An ember core is the substrate under real pressure but comfortably holding — the material equivalent of the seam's yield band seen in a static object.
entities.note: Deep surface, not seam. The lattice is packed, not straining to cross.

entities.name: Beacon cores
entities.summary: Pulsars and magnetars — a rhythm core whose beam externalizes a substrate clock.
entities.reading: A pulsar's lighthouse beat is, classically, rotation. In QTR it is prized as the steadiest natural externalization of a relational clock — a beacon core keeps time so cleanly that fleets once anchored ΛL phase to famous pulsars. A magnetar is a beacon core whose field is straining the local lattice toward, but not to, the seam.
entities.note: The natural timekeepers of the substrate. Navigation-grade.

entities.name: Natural seam-wells
entities.summary: Black holes — the classical sky's only natural approach to the seam.
entities.real_anchor: Stellar, intermediate and supermassive black holes.
entities.reading: A black hole is where the old universe reaches 𝔍 on its own, without a drive. Event density climbs toward the seam; the horizon is exactly the surface past which field language fails. Every black hole is therefore a natural seam-well — and, via ER=EPR, a potential unlit mouth of a Penrose bridge to a same-level neighbour.
entities.note: The single most important classical object for QTR: proof the seam is real and reachable.

entities.name: Kindled wells
entities.summary: A natural seam-well a drive has lit into an open, traversable crossing.
entities.reading: When a ship tunes a natural seam-well past the yield threshold — correct null alignment, a squeezed sub-vacuum window, a strong horizon gradient — the well kindles: the Idrenes Bridge opens and the black hole becomes a door. A kindled well is a substrate-native object because it exists only while a crossing is held open. Left alone, it darkens back to an ordinary seam-well.
entities.note: The lit form of a black hole. The civilized standard for intra-universe FTL anchoring.

entities.name: Correlation islands
entities.summary: Galaxies — coarse condensations of substrate correlation, not islands in a void.
entities.reading: A galaxy is a region where mutual information between events is dense enough to draw matter into a bound statistic. Its type (spiral, elliptical) is a classical morphology; underneath, all are correlation islands — local maxima of the same information field that, at larger scale, forms the tower lattice.

entities.name: The lattice web
entities.summary: Filaments, walls and voids — the OCT lattice of this universe seen edge-on.
entities.reading: The cosmic web is usually pictured as scaffolding matter hangs upon. QTR inverts it: the web is the mutual-information lattice that orders universes in the tower, glimpsed from inside one of its cells. A cosmic void is a low-information cell; a filament is a high-information seam between cells. Look at the web and you are looking at the bottom rungs of the OCT.
entities.note: The one classical structure that is literally a view of the tower.

entities.name: Field veils
entities.summary: Nebulae — regions where the vacuum medium is locally lit and legible.
entities.real_anchor: Emission, reflection, dark nebulae; H II regions; planetary nebulae.
entities.reading: A nebula is the vacuum medium made briefly visible — gas and dust, classically, but also a place where the structured vacuum's correlations are locally excited enough to read. Pilots treat bright nebulae as natural charts: the veil shows the shape of the medium they would otherwise navigate blind.
entities.note: The classical sky's free map of the vacuum terrain.

entities.name: Seam-pearls
entities.summary: Standing knots of pure seam-truth — regions locked at T• that never resolve.
entities.reading: Where a natural seam-well is held at the threshold by the geometry around it — not by a ship — a seam-pearl can form: a small, stable region permanently at ΛL value T•, simultaneously here and elsewhere. It is the closest thing the cosmos has to a naturally occurring open door, and the most coveted and dangerous find in the catalogue. A pearl neither collapses (Resurrection never fires) nor opens fully; it hums at the crossing forever.
entities.note: Self-dual under negation: ¬(pearl) = pearl. A contradiction the universe holds without exploding.

entities.name: Amplitude twins
entities.summary: Two objects identical but for a global phase — capable of interfering across the seam.
entities.reading: Because every sub-history carries a complex amplitude (P2), two regions can be identical in every measurable way and differ only in global phase. Amplitude twins are such pairs. They are the substrate's honest version of the "parallel-universe double": reachable without Κ, by phase-matching at the seam — and able, briefly, to interfere, producing the doppelgänger phenomena of old legend.
entities.note: The cheapest crossing in the cosmos, and the source of every double-self story.

entities.name: Seam-scars
entities.summary: The healed-over wake of a past crossing — a region the seam once tore and released.
entities.reading: When a crossing closes badly, it leaves a seam-scar: a region where the effective description is subtly wrong, conserved quantities slightly off, causal order faintly frayed. Scars are navigation hazards — the vacuum here lies to instruments — and archaeological treasures, because a scar records that someone crossed here before. Reading a scar is how the Assembly maps who has passed through.
entities.note: The fossil record of crossings. Where the bestiary meets history.

entities.name: Depth-wells
entities.summary: A region where the effective Planck length locally shortens — a rung of the tower breaking surface.
entities.reading: Most of the tower is inaccessible from inside a universe, but occasionally a rung breaks surface: a depth-well, where the effective Planck length is locally smaller than the universe's norm and a ship can, briefly, touch a deeper OCT level without a full dive. Depth-wells are how Class I ships punch above their rated speed — and how they are lost, when the well closes around them.
entities.note: The substrate equivalent of a mountain pass: a shortcut down the tower that may not stay open.

entities.name: Bridge-mouths
entities.summary: The paired black-hole / white-hole termini of an entanglement bridge between neighbours.
entities.real_anchor: No classical analogue (a re-read of the maximally-extended Penrose diagram).
entities.reading: A bridge-mouth is one end of a Penrose bridge: a black hole that is the ingoing mouth in universe A, or a white hole that is the ejecting mouth in universe B. Unlit, they look like ordinary compact objects. Lit and held open by a squeezed sub-vacuum, they are the lateral door between same-level universes — irreversible per throat, born-out never fallen-back.
entities.note: The adjacency-axis object. Two mouths, one throat, two universes.

entities.name: Information reefs
entities.summary: Dense shoals of mutual information where the lattice snags ships and signals alike.
entities.reading: Along the tower lattice, mutual information is not smooth — it shoals. An information reef is a region where correlation is so dense that causal order becomes hard to maintain and signals arrive out of sequence. Reefs are prized by the Assembly as natural archives (they remember everything that passes) and feared by pilots (they entangle a ship with its own past track).
entities.note: The lattice's memory made physical. Navigate with care; it remembers you.

entities.name: Refusal zones
entities.summary: Regions where geometry begins to refuse to close — the first edge-effect of Κ.
entities.reading: The nearest thing to a measurement of Κ. In a refusal zone, parallels slowly diverge where they should stay parallel, conserved quantities develop tiny leaks, and the ΛL value of "this region obeys our laws" drifts from T toward F. A refusal zone is not an object so much as a symptom — the substrate announcing that its own laws are beginning to disagree with themselves nearby.
entities.note: Κ is unmeasurable; a refusal zone is how you know you are near it anyway.

entities.name: Law-shards
entities.summary: Fragments where a region has re-solved into a different lawset — a shard of another constitution.
entities.reading: When a region is forced past Κ and re-solves, it does not always fully depart — sometimes a law-shard remains embedded in this universe: a small patch running on foreign rules, where this cosmos's constants quietly do not apply. Shards are the physical evidence that constitution-travel is real, and the only place the three Κ5 verdicts can, in principle, be tested — though testing one has never returned a witness.
entities.note: The disputed relics of the curvature frontier. Every faction wants one; none can read one safely.

entities.name: The Formless mouths
entities.summary: Rumoured apertures where Κ and the transfinite tower touch — the myth-ships' grail.
entities.reading: At the extreme, legend holds that where a refusal zone deepens near a transfinite OCT rung, a Formless mouth can open — an aperture that is simultaneously a Κ-fracture and a tower-crossing, through which the Madman's Theorem claims a ship could pass intact and return. The Assembly denies they exist. No verified sighting has survived scrutiny. They are the single object the mythical ship is built to find.
entities.note: The grail of the Κ5 controversy. Believed by almost none; sought by the one who matters.

entities.name: Relational quantum event (RQE)
entities.summary: The single primitive of QTR. A discrete occurrence whose only content is a placement in a partial order and a complex amplitude relative to a reference frame. Spacetime, fields, and every object are coarse statistics of these.

entities.name: QTR — Quantum Theory of Relativity
entities.summary: The substrate framework. Resolves the incompatibility of quantum mechanics and general relativity by finding a deeper layer from which both emerge — a partial order of relational quantum events.

entities.name: The four postulates (P1–P4)
entities.summary: P1 Atomicity — history is a locally finite partial order of events. P2 Amplitude — every finite sub-history carries an amplitude via a spin-foam sum. P3 Frames — all amplitudes are relative to an internal quantum reference frame. P4 Growth — the order grows one event at a time by a covariant stochastic rule ("becoming").

entities.name: P4 growth · becoming
entities.summary: The fourth postulate: the partial order is grown one event at a time by a covariant stochastic rule. This is the substrate's "becoming." Cosmic inflation and Steady State's continuous creation are both surface shadows of P4.

entities.name: Partial order
entities.summary: The causal skeleton of the substrate: events are ordered by which precede which, but not all pairs are comparable. Coarse-grained, this order becomes the causal structure of spacetime.

entities.name: Spin-foam amplitude
entities.summary: The complex amplitude (P2) assigned to every finite sub-history via a spin-foam sum. General relativity is recovered as the continuum limit of this sum; higher terms are what f(R) gravity guesses at by hand.

entities.name: Quantum reference frame
entities.summary: The internal frame relative to which every amplitude is defined (P3) — no amplitude is absolute. The slow reorientation of this frame across a universe's history is what quintessence models as a rolling scalar field.

entities.name: Effective layer
entities.summary: The shallow, field-theoretic description of reality that holds at the OCT-0 surface. All classical physics lives here. It is true but shallow: valid until event density climbs toward the seam, where field language fails.

entities.name: Emergence
entities.summary: The principle that spacetime, curvature, expansion and metric are not fundamental but are coarse statistics of relational quantum events. Entropic gravity is the classical theory that came closest to this insight.

entities.name: ΛL — the logic of the limit
entities.summary: A five-valued truth algebra (𝕍₅) for reasoning at, across, and beyond boundaries, where classical bivalence fails. Its five values map exactly onto the five physical regimes of QTR.

entities.name: T — classical true
entities.summary: The ordinary "true" of the calm regime, far from any limit. Also the epistemic status of the Absolute Verdict on Κ5 — settled, taught, and self-sealing.

entities.name: F — classical false
entities.summary: Ordinary "false." The value assigned to models QTR supersedes outright, such as Steady State and tired light — and the value a region's "obeys our laws" proposition drifts toward as it nears Κ.

entities.name: T⁻ — left-approach · IR
entities.summary: The truth-value of approaching a limit from the infrared (low-density) side. The state of a ship's early approach to the seam, and the ΛL reading of inflation and MOND.

entities.name: T⁺ — right-approach · UV
entities.summary: The truth-value of approaching from the ultraviolet (high-density) side. The status of theories reaching toward the substrate from above — entropic gravity, the multiverse — and of the Madman's Theorem on Κ5.

entities.name: T• — seam-truth
entities.summary: The self-dual value at the seam: ¬(T•) = T•. A contradiction does not explode into falsity — it produces more seam-truth. This is the logical form of being in two places at once during a crossing, and the status of the Tragic Truth on Κ5.

entities.name: Resurrection
entities.summary: The ΛL rule that beyond a seam, classical bivalence is restored — a superposition collapses to a definite T or F. When a ship re-condenses at its destination, Resurrection is firing. The Big Bounce is this rule at cosmic scale.

entities.name: Seam incompleteness
entities.summary: ΛL proves its own incompleteness as an internal theorem — it sees its own seam, where prior systems (Peano, ZFC) could not. The same reflexive structure appears in OCT-Ω and in the unmeasurability of Κ.

entities.name: Noether correspondence
entities.summary: The bijection between the four QTR postulates and the four core ΛL inference rules: P1 Atomicity ↔ Anti-Transfer, P2 Amplitudes ↔ Both-Sides Agreement, P3 Frames ↔ Seam Paraconsistency, P4 Growth ↔ Resurrection. The precise sense in which QTR is the physics of a ΛL universe.

entities.name: PIIU — Physics of Infinite Infinity Universes
entities.summary: The hierarchy layer. Infinite universes nest in the Omniverse Cantor Tower, ordered by mutual information. A ship's speed is set by how deep into the tower it can reach — not by the universe.

entities.name: Omniverse Cantor Tower (OCT)
entities.summary: The transfinite hierarchy nesting infinite universes, ranked by the mutual information between them. Each level has a smaller effective Planck length — and a ship reaching it travels exponentially faster.

entities.name: OCT levels (0/1/2/ω)
entities.summary: OCT-0 is intra-universe (Class I ships, ~10¹⁰c). OCT-1 is inter-universe within a pocket (Class II). OCT-2 spans domains of pockets (Class III). OCT-ω is the first transfinite level (Class ω, the Formless).

entities.name: OCT-Ω — the top
entities.summary: The fixed point of the entire hierarchy — the seam of the Omniverse itself. Acknowledged but never crossed; PIIU cannot describe it from within any finite or ω-level description. It is the theory's own Gödel sentence.

entities.name: Mutual information
entities.summary: The quantity that orders universes in the tower and binds structure within one. The "coupling" of interacting-dark-sector models is a proxy for it; the cosmic web is it, drawn as matter.

entities.name: Effective Planck length
entities.summary: The granularity scale of a given OCT level. It shortens as you descend the tower, which is why a deeper dive buys exponentially more speed. A depth-well is a place it locally shortens.

entities.name: OCT-0 surface
entities.summary: The effective sky of one universe — where field language holds and all classical objects live. The "home" depth of the seventeen classical cosmological models.

entities.name: Ship-Relative Speed Law
entities.summary: The law making a ship's velocity a function of the OCT depth it can reach, not of thrust: v = c·exp(S_eff − ln(D/ℓ)). Speed is depth. This is why Κ is not about acceleration — going faster means diving deeper, not pushing harder.

entities.name: The seam 𝔍
entities.summary: The locus where the effective description breaks down: RQE density approaches the Planck density, mutual information saturates the Bekenstein bound, and causal depth diverges. The crossable threshold — and the marked boundary between real and invented physics.

entities.name: The crossing
entities.summary: The native seam event and the basis of all FTL: the approach (T⁻) drives density up, phase-lock (T•) opens the Idrenes Bridge and the ship is here-and-there at once, and Resurrection collapses it to a definite "there."

entities.name: The approach
entities.summary: The first phase of a crossing: the drive concentrates the substrate until field language begins to fail and the ΛL value slides from T toward the seam. The survivable band — the yield, not the fracture. All FTL lives here.

entities.name: Phase-lock
entities.summary: The instant of crossing: correct null alignment, a squeezed sub-vacuum window, and a strong horizon gradient align at once, the Idrenes Bridge opens, and the ship holds ΛL value T• — here and there at once.

entities.name: Idrenes Bridge
entities.summary: The Einstein–Rosen bridge that opens at phase-lock, connecting entangled regions (ER=EPR at the event level). The mechanism of a seam-crossing. Named for the Idrenes–Sōrn drive that first controlled it.

entities.name: ER=EPR
entities.summary: The principle, at the event level, that entangled regions share an Einstein–Rosen bridge. It makes seam-crossings possible and turns any black hole into a potential bridge-mouth to a same-level neighbour.

entities.name: Failed condensation
entities.summary: A crossing where Resurrection misfires and the ship does not fully re-condense — half-landing, leaving a seam-scar and sometimes an amplitude twin. The signature disaster of the seam.

entities.name: The honest boundary
entities.summary: The design principle that everything down to the seam rests on real quantum field theory (Casimir, Unruh, Hawking, Parker) and the seam is exactly where rigorous physics ends and invented physics begins. The seam is a construction tool that became a character.

entities.name: The three axes
entities.summary: The three independent coordinates by which a universe is "another": Depth (vertical, the tower), Adjacency (horizontal, same-level neighbours), and Constitution (different laws). Each has its own door.

entities.name: Depth axis
entities.summary: The vertical axis: universes stacked in the OCT tower by mutual information. Its door is the seam 𝔍 / Idrenes Bridge; its event is the dive. Diving deeper buys exponentially more speed.

entities.name: Adjacency axis
entities.summary: The horizontal axis: same-level universes joined by entanglement. Its door is a Penrose bridge (black hole ↔ white hole); its event is bridge-transit. Lateral moves only — no change of depth.

entities.name: Constitution axis
entities.summary: The deepest axis: universes built on a different selection of substrate laws. Its door is surpassing the curvature limit Κ; its event is the fracture. The only door that changes the laws themselves.

entities.name: Penrose bridge
entities.summary: The adjacency door: a single entangled Einstein–Rosen throat whose two mouths are a black hole in one universe and a white hole in a same-level neighbour. Held open by a squeezed sub-vacuum. One-way per throat.

entities.name: Bridge-transit
entities.summary: The adjacency event: entering a lit bridge-mouth as an irreversible fall and being ejected from the paired white-hole mouth in a neighbouring universe. Changes neighbour, never depth; cannot be reversed through the same throat.

entities.name: Three limits
entities.summary: The three kinds of edge the tower has: 𝔍 (edge of description — crossable, you return, changes location), Ω (edge of hierarchy — never crossed, the fixed point), and Κ (edge of law — changes the kind of universe, unmeasurable).

entities.name: Curvature limit Κ
entities.summary: The maximum curvature — the event-lattice packing density — the substrate's laws can sustain (P1–P4). Not a speed you exceed but a tolerance you violate: cross it and the region re-solves into different laws. Globally unmeasurable.

entities.name: Yield vs fracture (Κ2)
entities.summary: The clause that the seam 𝔍 sits just below Κ, as a yield point sits below a fracture point. All FTL flies in the band between comfortable physics and Κ — approaching the limit without breaching it.

entities.name: Transmutation (Κ3)
entities.summary: The clause that crossing Κ is transmutation, not transit: past the limit the local postulates cannot all hold, so the region re-solves into a different lawset. No one arrives — a patch of here becomes a there.

entities.name: Unmeasurability (Κ4)
entities.summary: The clause that the global Κ of an infinite closed universe cannot be measured from within — a bounded observer cannot sum an unbounded interior. Known only by edge-effects. The same reflexive structure as ΛL's self-incompleteness and OCT-Ω.

entities.name: The refusal
entities.summary: The Κ-approach event: edge-effects set in — parallels bow apart, conservation leaks, and the ΛL value of "this region obeys our laws" slides T → T• → F. Unlike the seam's clean yield, the refusal has no springback. The only warning Κ gives.

entities.name: The fracture
entities.summary: The constitution event: a region forced past Κ re-solves into a different lawset. The crossing the entire Κ5 controversy is about.

entities.name: Κ5 — the verdict controversy
entities.summary: The contested clause on what survives a Κ-crossing. Three verdicts hold the field at once, each with a different epistemic status, forming a closed trap: the consensus is unfalsifiable, the truth unconfirmable, and the only breaker is a mocked theory.

entities.name: The Absolute Verdict
entities.summary: The consensus outcome (ΛL value T): nothing survives a Κ-crossing — annihilation-into-genesis. Unfalsifiable from the safe side because Κ never returns a counterexample. Taught by the Pelagian Assembly.

entities.name: The Tragic Truth
entities.summary: What may truly happen (ΛL value T•): substance cannot cross, but a pattern — a mind, a message — can be re-encoded into the far lawset, arriving translated and unable ever to signal back. Condemned to look identical to the Absolute Verdict from outside. Unwitnessed success.

entities.name: The Madman's Theorem
entities.summary: The crank hypothesis (ΛL value T⁺): a mythical ship holds a Κ-fracture open, passes through intact, and returns. Dismissed by all serious authority — yet the only possible falsifier of the Absolute Verdict, since a returning ship is the one witness Κ forbids.

entities.name: Closed epistemic trap
entities.summary: The self-sealing structure of the Κ5 controversy: the consensus is unfalsifiable, the truth is unconfirmable, and the one thing that could break the deadlock is the theory everyone mocks. This is what keeps Κ a live, dangerous frontier.

entities.name: Idrenes–Sōrn drive
entities.jp: イドレネス・ソーン機関
entities.summary: The standard Infinity-technology drive that controls a seam-crossing by opening an Idrenes Bridge. In its OCT-0 form it is mass-produced interstellar FTL — the civilized standard.

entities.name: Infinity technology
entities.summary: The umbrella term for technology that operates at the seam rather than below it — everything that makes crossing, diving, and bridge-transit possible.

entities.name: Ship classes (0–ω)
entities.summary: Class 0 (Crawlers, sub-light) → Class I (Bridges, intra-universe ~10¹⁰c) → Class II (Wanderers, inter-universe) → Class III (Sovereigns, inter-pocket) → Class ω (the Formless). A ship's class equals the maximum vacuum depth it can reach.

entities.name: The dive
entities.summary: The depth-axis event: a ship reaching a deeper OCT rung, where the effective Planck length is shorter and the Ship-Relative Speed Law grants exponentially more velocity. A dive is what changes a ship's class.

entities.name: Squeezed sub-vacuum
entities.summary: A cold pocket of the vacuum where squeezing suppresses some fluctuations and amplifies others, opening a low-cost window of negative energy. It is the resource that both enables phase-lock and holds a Penrose bridge open. One physics, two uses.

entities.name: Vacuum navigation
entities.summary: The operational discipline: the vacuum is a structured medium of correlations, modes, and horizons, navigated on two axes — longitudinal (route within a regime) and vertical (state-depth). The vertical axis is the operational path to the seam.

entities.name: Instrument-flying
entities.summary: The principle that a ship crosses the seam not blindfolded but on instruments: where field language fails, ΛL takes over as the navigation instrument. All seamanship happens configuring boundary conditions on approach; the undescribable interior is never navigated directly.

entities.name: Natural seam-well
entities.summary: A black hole, re-read: the classical sky's only natural approach to the seam, where event density climbs toward 𝔍 without a drive. Via ER=EPR, a potential unlit mouth of a Penrose bridge.

entities.name: Kindled well
entities.summary: A natural seam-well a drive has lit into an open, traversable crossing — a black hole become a door. It exists only while a crossing is held open; left alone it darkens back to an ordinary seam-well.

entities.name: Seam-pearl
entities.summary: A small region held permanently at ΛL value T• by the geometry around it — simultaneously here and elsewhere. A naturally occurring open door that neither collapses nor opens fully; it hums at the crossing forever. The most coveted and dangerous find.

entities.name: Amplitude twin
entities.summary: Two objects identical in every measurable way but for a global phase (P2), capable of briefly interfering across the seam. The substrate's honest version of the parallel-universe double — reachable without Κ, by phase-matching.

entities.name: Bridge-mouth
entities.summary: One terminus of a Penrose bridge: a black hole (ingoing mouth) in one universe, or a white hole (ejecting mouth) in a same-level neighbour. Unlit they look like ordinary compact objects; lit, they are the adjacency door.

entities.name: Depth-well
entities.summary: A region where the effective Planck length locally shortens — a rung of the tower breaking surface. How a Class I ship punches above its rated speed, and how it is lost when the well closes around it.

entities.name: Information reef
entities.summary: A shoal of dense mutual information where causal order frays and signals arrive out of sequence. A natural archive that remembers all that passes, and a hazard where a ship entangles with its own past track.

entities.name: Refusal zone
entities.summary: A region where geometry begins to refuse to close — the first edge-effect of Κ. Not an object but a symptom: the substrate announcing its own laws are beginning to disagree with themselves. The only way to know you are near Κ.

entities.name: Law-shard
entities.summary: A fragment where a region has re-solved into a different lawset — a patch of this universe running on foreign rules. The only physical evidence that constitution-travel is real, and the only place the Κ5 verdicts might be tested.

entities.name: The Formless mouths
entities.summary: Rumoured apertures where Κ and the transfinite tower touch — through which the Madman's Theorem claims a ship could pass intact and return. The Assembly denies they exist; the mythical ship is built to find them.

entities.name: Seam-scar
entities.summary: The healed-over wake of a past crossing — a region where the effective description is subtly wrong. A hazard to instruments and an archaeological record of who crossed here before.

entities.name: The lattice web
entities.summary: The cosmic web — filaments, walls, voids — re-read as the OCT lattice of this universe seen edge-on. The one classical structure that is literally a view of the tower.

entities.name: Correlation island
entities.summary: A galaxy, re-read: a region where mutual information is dense enough to bind matter into a statistic. Its type is classical morphology; its substance is the same information field that forms the tower.

entities.name: Causal tangle
entities.summary: The hazard event on an information reef: the reef's dense mutual information binds a ship to its own earlier passage, and signals begin arriving out of order. Reading one's way out is a core discipline of deep-lattice navigation.

entities.name: Hazard spine
entities.summary: The organizing axis of vacuum hazards, from Swallow (the vacuum losing structure, going still) through Calm to Erupt (the vacuum precipitating real quanta), crossed by whether the ship caused the state or the region imposed it.

entities.name: Core fall
entities.summary: Core-collapse supernovae, re-read: the old universe driving a region toward the seam unaided. Every core fall is a natural experiment in seam-approach, birthing a seam-well and flushing the rest as light.

entities.name: Big Bounce (re-read)
entities.summary: The bouncing-cosmology model, re-read: the Resurrection rule fired at cosmic scale. Contraction is a T⁺ approach to the seam; the seam itself is T•; re-expansion is Resurrection collapsing to a definite state on the far side.

entities.name: The early beat
entities.summary: Cosmic inflation, re-read: P4 firing fast as a new chart nucleates near its IR edge. The fastest becoming a universe undergoes; it lays the seed statistics of all later structure.

entities.name: IR boundary
entities.summary: What classical cosmology calls the Big Bang: not the start of everything but the IR edge of one universe's chart — a T⁻ left-approach to a seam, read from inside.

entities.name: Pelagian Assembly
entities.summary: The institution that teaches the Absolute Verdict on Κ5 and maintains the codex. Its authority rests on a verdict that is unfalsifiable from the safe side — a certainty manufactured by the frontier it describes.

entities.name: The mythical ship
entities.summary: The single obsessive craft that chases the Formless mouths, attempting the Aperture gambit to prove the Madman's Theorem. Believed by almost none — yet the only agent pursuing the one event that could break the closed epistemic trap.

entities.name: The Tragic passage
entities.summary: A completed Κ-crossing under the Pattern-only verdict: a pattern successfully re-encoded into a far lawset, arrived and changed, unable ever to report home. Indistinguishable from annihilation to anyone watching from the safe side.

entities.name: Mars
entities.summary: Oldest continuously settled ground outside the birthworld; homeland of the conservative sister-tongue Rudgar, which alone kept *w and *h. Disproportionately the birthplace of Assembly cantors and Wolori lectors.

entities.name: Maren

entities.name: Old Pelagic

entities.name: Sūchel
entities.summary: Daughter of Old Pelagic via seven sound changes; tongue of the horizontal crosser fleet. Grammaticalizes the seam: five veridical moods, three temporal anchors, depth directionals, the gap-particle ne. Says 'jel'.

entities.name: The Irrationals

entities.name: The Dead Sea
entities.summary: Uniform vacuum, zero gradient. The absolute swallow pole. Motion dies in it — propulsion burns, the ship does not move. The most quietly terrifying hazard, because nothing is happening.
entities.behaviour: Stillness that eats disturbance. The shipu2019s wake decays to nothing.
entities.houdini: Dissipation maxed, all forces zero. Wake decaying to prove the stillness is hungry, not empty.
entities.escape: Resolve — find a gradient you cannot make. Drift on reserves, listen for a distant shear at the edge. Never power.

entities.name: Sub-Vacuum Undertow
entities.summary: You squeezed the vacuum for a cheap crossing. It drains, goes still and inviting u2014 then the compression debt slams back from below. The only hazard that crosses the whole spine in one gesture.
entities.behaviour: Rarefaction, then a single violent collapse inward. A swallow that turns into a brief erupt.
entities.houdini: Density draining to clear, unnatural stillness, then a shockwave compression from the edges.
entities.escape: Resolve — brace and pay the debt. Every discount is a trap with a delayed spring; the rebound always comes.

entities.name: Horizon Lock
entities.summary: A viscous region captures your wake and holds it suspended alongside older trapped wakes. You consume everything while going nowhere u2014 though it looks like progress. The ghost-fleet accumulates here.
entities.behaviour: High-viscosity capture, everything slowing to a hanging stop. A swallow that immobilises rather than destroys.
entities.houdini: Extreme viscosity, motion decaying to suspension, the derelict wakes held in the volume.
entities.escape: Resolve — cut all thrust before you are held. Stuck at Tu2022 u2014 unable to apply Resurrection.

entities.name: Calm Vacuum
entities.summary: Velvet black, a barely-alive ripple-skin. The default state of the sea u2014 minimal, near-static, so any deviation reads. This is the water you sail when nothing is wrong.
entities.behaviour: Near-static density, faint surface ripple. No net motion.
entities.houdini: Minimal ambient Pyro, near-zero forces. The contrast baseline for every hazard.
entities.escape: Resolve — nothing to resolve. This is the safe state you are trying to return to.

entities.name: Casimir Corridor
entities.summary: The one hazard that is an asset. You reshaped the mode spectrum and made a favourable current. The same act that causes the Squall when done violently creates a fair lane when done with care.
entities.behaviour: Smooth laminar lanes, mirror-mode channels. The vacuum driven well.
entities.houdini: Clean directed flow, no turbulence. Cold steel and thin white u2014 the specular safe lane.
entities.escape: Reward — the sea, touched well, carries you. The Squallu2019s twin at gentler speed u2014 punishment vs mastery.

entities.name: The Great Drift
entities.summary: The Parker current of cosmological expansion. Vast, slow, parallel, irresistible u2014 readable only across huge distances. Dangerous precisely because it looks like nothing and moves you anyway.
entities.behaviour: Perfect laminar flow, no turbulence at all. The absence of chaos is the signature.
entities.houdini: Enormous parallel velocity sheets, near-invisible density. Subtle by nature.
entities.escape: Resolve — read it early on the long baseline, or be carried for generations.

entities.name: Correlation Shear
entities.summary: Where two vacuum regions of different character meet and tear. The visual of a seam u2014 the same rolling curl you use for the Dead Sea escape, and a preview of the ultimate crossing between universes.
entities.behaviour: Vortex sheets, Kelvinu2013Helmholtz billows at the boundary only. Curl localised to the interface.
entities.houdini: Two volumes shearing, rolling-wave curl where they meet. Plant this before the climax.
entities.escape: Resolve — cross square to the null directions, or be thrown off heading.

entities.name: Horizon Surf
entities.summary: The standing tempest at a black holeu2019s edge. Permanent energetic fog, endless folding, temporal drift so strong that signals arrive time-shifted. An erupt that never stops u2014 the region is the engine.
entities.behaviour: Eternal recirculation, a waterfall that never empties. Phase-shifted light and sound.
entities.houdini: Continuous churn at a boundary, folding in on itself forever. Signals arrive before they are spoken.
entities.escape: Resolve — skirt it as a named skill. The water here is always breaking.

entities.name: The Cavitation Squall
entities.summary: You drove too fast and the vacuum condenses into upward rain. Real quanta precipitate out of the sea and hammer the hull. The erupt pole u2014 and the hazard you inflict on yourself.
entities.behaviour: Nucleation from within, cascading to outward eruption biased at the hull. The sea condenses into rain.
entities.houdini: Scattered ignition from inside the volume, buoyancy and turbulence unleashed. Coppery not-fire.
entities.escape: Resolve — stop driving. Cut modulation, go still, let the sea fall to ground state. Salvation is restraint.

entities.name: Scarred Water
entities.summary: Not a state of energy but of history. Where any ship passed, the vacuum holds a lingering channel of altered density. Every hazard, once traversed, leaves this behind u2014 the map is never the same twice.
entities.behaviour: Slow-healing displacement, a wake that refuses to close. Sits outside the energy axis u2014 it is about time.
entities.houdini: Persistent carved tunnels in the volume, very slow dissipation. Your mutable-map engine.
entities.escape: Resolve — nothing to escape u2014 but the route you carved now changes the next passage.

entities.name: The Sōrn drive
entities.summary: The FTL drive of the setting — 'the threader' (*sow-orn). Drives a ship's local region toward the seam 𝔍 until phase-lock opens an Idrenes bridge, then rides the crossing to a definite elsewhere. Its name is identical in every fleet tongue.

entities.name: The Idrenes bridge
entities.summary: The entanglement bridge a crossing opens — an Einstein–Rosen throat between a seam-approach here and a destination elsewhere, held via ER=EPR. One-way per throat; the physical basis of all FTL and adjacency travel.

entities.name: Casimir field-sail
entities.summary: Metastructured field-sails that reshape the local mode spectrum into a rideable corridor — the vacuum-engineering effect powering the Class I Casimir Sailer. Boundary conditions used as propulsion.

entities.name: Unruh thermal resampling
entities.summary: Controlled acceleration that changes the vacuum a ship perceives thermally — the vertical-descent effect of the Unruh Catamaran, letting a hull sample deeper vacuum state-structure.

entities.name: Squeezed-vacuum window
entities.summary: Resonant cavities and parametric pumps that prepare squeezed states, opening a temporary negative-energy window to discount a seam approach — essential to the curvature crossing, and the cause of the Undertow's rebound debt.

entities.name: The beacon network
entities.summary: Pulsars promoted to a civilization's timekeeping backbone: beacon cores keep relational time so cleanly that fleets anchor ΛL phase to them. Coverage has an edge; beyond it lies dark time. Whoever controls the beacons controls 'when'.

entities.name: Depth axis
entities.summary: The canonical axis. A ship's class is the maximum depth it can reach; the Ship-Relative Speed Law makes velocity a function of depth, not thrust. Moving down is refinement; moving up is toward the fixed point Ω.

entities.name: Adjacency axis
entities.summary: The lateral axis. ER=EPR at the event level makes a black hole in one universe and a white hole in another the two mouths of one bridge. Entering is an irreversible fall; exiting is a violent birth. One-way per throat.
entities.door: black hole ↔ white hole · Penrose bridge

entities.name: Constitution axis
entities.summary: The deepest axis, and the only door that changes the laws themselves. Reached not by motion but by forcing a region past its constitutive tolerance Κ, so it can only stay consistent by adopting different rules. The unmeasurable frontier.

entities.name: ΛCDM
entities.summary: The correct effective statistics of RQE density in one universe. Recovered exactly — but Λ is a level-local constant, not universal.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: ~5% ordinary matter, ~27% cold dark matter, ~68% dark energy as a cosmological constant Λ; Big Bang plus inflation.
entities.got_right: The coarse-grained bookkeeping of event density is exactly right. The CMB, light-element abundances and structure growth are faithful surface statistics of the substrate.
entities.mistook: That Λ is a universal constant and spacetime a fixed stage. In QTR both are OCT-0 residues; Λ is the vacuum-energy signature of this level, differing across the tower.
entities.reframe_long: QTR reproduces ΛCDM in the continuum limit — the Regge action converges to Einstein–Hilbert, and the concordance parameters fall out as the leading statistics of relational quantum events. Nothing measured is discarded. What changes is status: dark energy is not a substance but the effective vacuum term of OCT-0, and cold dark matter is the coarse imprint of sub-surface correlations the field description cannot resolve individually. ΛCDM is true — as far down as fields can see.

entities.name: wCDM / CPL
entities.summary: A time-varying w(t) is the shadow of event-growth rate drift — the P4 stochastic rule sampled through a field lens.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: dark energy with an equation of state w that may differ from −1 and evolve in time (the CPL parametrization tracks the drift).
entities.got_right: That the vacuum term need not be constant. The instinct to let w breathe points, correctly, below the fixed-Λ approximation.
entities.mistook: That the drift is a property of a dark-energy fluid. In QTR it is the field-level readout of P4 growth — the covariant stochastic rule building the order at a rate that itself varies.
entities.reframe_long: When QTR's becoming rule (Postulate 4) runs slightly faster or slower as a chart evolves, an observer confined to the surface reads it as an evolving equation of state. wCDM is thus a genuine left-approach (T⁻) toward the growth substrate: it is measuring the derivative of becoming, while believing it measures a fluid. Recent survey hints of evolving w are, in this frame, the first field-level detection of P4.

entities.name: Quintessence
entities.summary: The rolling field φ is a collective coordinate for the quantum reference frame — P3 seen as a scalar.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: dark energy as a dynamic scalar field φ rolling down a potential, its density changing over cosmic history.
entities.got_right: That the acceleration might come from a dynamical degree of freedom, not a constant. Correct — but the degree of freedom is not a new particle.
entities.mistook: That φ is a fundamental field on spacetime. In QTR it is an emergent collective coordinate tracking how the internal quantum reference frame (P3) reorients as the chart grows.
entities.reframe_long: Because no amplitude in QTR is absolute — all are relative to an internal frame (Postulate 3) — the slow reorientation of that frame across a universe's history looks, from the surface, exactly like a scalar field rolling. Quintessence models the frame's drift and calls it φ. It is a faithful shadow of P3, which is why it works phenomenologically and why it will never be found as a particle.

entities.name: ΛWDM
entities.summary: A coarse-graining choice: warm vs cold sets the resolution length at which sub-surface correlations are smeared. A limit, not a rival.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: dark matter as lighter, faster "warm" particles (e.g. sterile neutrinos), erasing the smallest structures.
entities.got_right: That the small-scale structure is over-counted by cold dark matter. The free-streaming cutoff is a real feature of how correlations blur.
entities.mistook: That the fix is a particle mass. In QTR the warm/cold distinction is a choice of coarse-graining scale over sub-surface RQE correlations — the same substrate, read at a coarser grain.
entities.reframe_long: QTR has no fundamental dark-matter particle at OCT-0; there is only the effective imprint of correlations below the field resolution. Choosing "warm" simply sets a longer smoothing length, cutting off the finest structure. WDM is therefore recovered as a limit of ΛCDM under a specific coarse-graining, and the small-scale tensions it addresses are real artefacts of resolving substrate correlations too finely.

entities.name: Interacting dark sector
entities.summary: The "coupling" is mutual information between correlation sectors — P2 amplitude structure misread as an energy exchange.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: dark matter and dark energy exchange energy, a coupling introduced to ease the H₀ and S₈ tensions.
entities.got_right: That the dark sector is not two independent things. Correct — but they are not exchanging energy; they were never separate substances.
entities.mistook: That there is a flow of energy between fluids. In QTR both are surface readouts of the same spin-foam amplitude structure (P2); their apparent coupling is the mutual information the field picture cannot represent directly.
entities.reframe_long: The interacting-dark-sector program is groping toward a true fact — that dark matter and dark energy are aspects of one substrate object — but expresses it in the only language it has, an energy exchange between two fluids. QTR says the "coupling constant" is a proxy for mutual information between correlation sectors of the same amplitude sum. That is why tuning it eases the tensions: it is partially restoring a substrate correlation the two-fluid split destroyed.

entities.name: MOND / TeVeS
entities.summary: a₀ is not a new law — it is the scale where RQE granularity surfaces. MOND is measuring the substrate's graininess and calling it modified inertia.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: gravity changes below a critical acceleration a₀, reproducing galaxy rotation curves without dark matter.
entities.got_right: That the discrepancy appears at a characteristic acceleration, not a characteristic mass or distance. This is a deep and correct clue.
entities.mistook: That the fix is a modification of dynamics. In QTR a₀ marks the acceleration at which the discrete event structure of the substrate begins to affect coarse-grained motion — a granularity scale, not a force law.
entities.reframe_long: MOND's enduring puzzle is why one acceleration scale governs galaxies. QTR answers: a₀ is where the continuum approximation to relational quantum events starts to fail for a given trajectory. Below it, coarse-grained inertia inherits a correction from the underlying order. MOND is thus a genuine surface detection of substrate granularity — which is why it triumphs on galactic scales (near a₀) and stumbles on cosmological ones (far from it), where the granularity correction is negligible and ΛCDM's statistics dominate.

entities.name: f(R) gravity
entities.summary: A truncation of the spin-foam expansion. The f(R) terms are the leading corrections QTR predicts when Einstein–Hilbert is only the first term.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: replace the curvature scalar R in the Einstein–Hilbert action with a function f(R), producing acceleration without dark energy.
entities.got_right: That Einstein–Hilbert is not the whole action. Adding higher-curvature terms is the right instinct about the gravitational sector.
entities.mistook: That one chooses f(R) by hand. In QTR the correction terms are not free — they are fixed outputs of the spin-foam sum (P2), of which Einstein–Hilbert is the continuum leading order.
entities.reframe_long: QTR derives gravity as the IR limit of a spin-foam amplitude; expanding beyond leading order generates precisely the higher-curvature invariants that f(R) and related theories insert by hand. So f(R) is recovered as a limit — a truncation of a series QTR fixes uniquely. Where f(R) theorists have a free function, QTR has a computed one, which is why most hand-picked f(R) forms fail: they are guessing at a term the substrate already determines.

entities.name: Entropic gravity
entities.summary: The closest classical guess to QTR — gravity as emergent from information. It reaches for the substrate but stops at the horizon, blind to the seam beyond.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: gravity is not fundamental but emerges from entropy and information encoded on horizons (Verlinde).
entities.got_right: Almost everything directional: that gravity is emergent, that information and horizons are central, that spacetime is derived rather than given. The right target.
entities.mistook: That the emergence bottoms out at horizon thermodynamics. QTR agrees gravity is entropic — but the horizon entropy is itself a coarse statistic of relational quantum events, and the real structure is the seam the horizon only approximates.
entities.reframe_long: Of all classical programs, entropic gravity is the one QTR most nearly ratifies: it correctly names gravity as emergent and information as fundamental. Its limit is that it takes the horizon and its Bekenstein entropy as bedrock, when in QTR the Bekenstein bound is exactly one of the three quantities that diverges at the seam 𝔍. Entropic gravity is a right-approach (T⁺) from the UV side — it is climbing toward the seam from above and mistaking the last ledge for the summit.

entities.name: Cosmic inflation
entities.summary: Not a field-driven epoch but the early, rapid regime of P4 growth near the chart's IR edge — becoming, running hot and fast.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: a brief exponential expansion in the first instants, explaining the universe's homogeneity, flatness and structure seeds.
entities.got_right: That the early universe underwent a phase of extreme, smoothing expansion, and that quantum fluctuations seeded structure. Both are real substrate behaviours.
entities.mistook: That it was driven by an inflaton field on pre-existing spacetime. In QTR there is no stage yet to inflate; the epoch is the substrate growing its own order rapidly near the IR boundary — the inflaton is the field-language name for early P4.
entities.reframe_long: Inflation's successes — flatness, homogeneity, a near-scale-invariant spectrum — are exactly what QTR predicts when the covariant growth rule (P4) fires quickly as a new chart nucleates near its IR edge. The "inflaton potential" is a surface parametrization of the becoming rate. This is why no inflaton has been found and why the model is generative anyway: it is measuring early P4 through a scalar-field proxy, a genuine T⁻ approach to the growth substrate.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.summary: The unordered sketch of the Omniverse Cantor Tower. It guesses many universes but gives them no hierarchy, no mutual information, no depth — an OCT with the structure removed.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: eternal inflation spawns countless bubble universes, each with its own constants; hard to test.
entities.got_right: That ours is not the only universe, and that constants can differ between them. QTR ratifies both — emphatically.
entities.mistook: That the universes form an unstructured ensemble with no relations among them. The OCT is precisely the missing structure: universes nest by mutual information into a transfinite tower with a definite depth ordering the multiverse lacks.
entities.reframe_long: The inflationary multiverse arrives at the right ontology — infinitely many universes — but flattens it into a bag of disconnected bubbles, which is why it resists testability. QTR's PIIU layer supplies the order the multiverse omits: the Omniverse Cantor Tower ranks universes by mutual information, gives each level a smaller effective Planck length, and makes "which universe" a question of depth. The multiverse is a T⁺ approach to the tower — reaching toward it from below, blind to the levels.

entities.name: Cyclic / ekpyrotic
entities.summary: The brane collision is a shadow of a seam-crossing. Cyclic models feel the return through 𝔍 but describe it with branes instead of the logic of the limit.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: infinite cycles of expansion and contraction, the Big Bang arising from colliding branes in string theory.
entities.got_right: That the "beginning" can be a transition from a prior state, not an absolute origin — and that it recurs. Both are seam behaviours.
entities.mistook: That the transition is a brane collision in a higher space. In QTR the passage from one phase to the next is a crossing of the seam 𝔍, governed by ΛL — the point is self-dual seam-truth (T•), not a mechanical impact.
entities.reframe_long: Cyclic and ekpyrotic cosmologies sense the deepest thing on this list: that what looks like an origin is a crossing, and that it repeats. But branes are a field-theoretic picture imported to describe something field language cannot hold. QTR names the transition directly: it is the seam 𝔍, where the effective description breaks down and ΛL's seam-truth T• governs — the same self-dual value a ship occupies mid-crossing. The cyclic model is seam-adjacent, feeling the crossing without the logic to be there.

entities.name: Big Bounce
entities.summary: The bounce is the Resurrection rule firing at cosmic scale — the substrate declining to reach the singularity, re-condensing on the far side of 𝔍.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: a prior universe contracts to finite maximum density and re-expands; a bounce replaces the Big Bang singularity (loop quantum gravity).
entities.got_right: That there is no singularity — that a finite-density transition replaces it. QTR agrees completely: the substrate never reaches the divergence.
entities.mistook: That the bounce is a quantum-geometric repulsion. In QTR it is the ΛL Resurrection rule at cosmic scale: approaching the seam, bivalence is suspended (T•), then restored on the far side — the universe re-condenses definitely "there."
entities.reframe_long: Loop-quantum bounce cosmology and QTR converge on the same refusal: the singularity is never attained. Where the bounce invokes a repulsive quantum-geometry term, QTR reads the event through its logic. Contraction is a right-approach (T⁺) to the seam; the seam itself is T•; and re-expansion is Resurrection — the collapse of seam-truth back to a definite classical value on the other side. The bounce is the cosmological instance of exactly what a ship does when it crosses.

entities.name: Steady State
entities.summary: Superseded — but its continuous creation of matter is an accidental glimpse of P4: the substrate really does grow new events one at a time.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: an eternal universe with no beginning, matter continuously created to hold density constant; refuted by the CMB.
entities.got_right: A single true intuition, for the wrong reason: that the universe grows by continual addition. P4 is exactly continual addition — of events, not atoms.
entities.mistook: Almost everything else: no beginning, no hot early phase, a steady field-filled space. The CMB refutes the surface model outright; QTR keeps only the creation instinct.
entities.reframe_long: Steady State is classically false (F) — the CMB alone is fatal to it. QTR does not resurrect the model. But it notes a poignant coincidence: Hoyle's continuous creation of matter, invented to avoid a beginning, rhymes with Postulate 4, where the substrate genuinely grows one relational quantum event at a time. Steady State reached for the right verb — becoming — and attached it to the wrong noun. The model dies; the verb survives in QTR.

entities.name: Void models (LTB)
entities.summary: A valid limit: relaxing homogeneity is legitimate at the surface. QTR keeps the inhomogeneous chart but denies the observer's special place.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: we sit near the centre of a giant void whose inhomogeneity mimics acceleration, removing the need for dark energy.
entities.got_right: That homogeneity is an assumption, not a law. The substrate's event density is genuinely uneven; inhomogeneous charts are physically admissible.
entities.mistook: That we occupy a special central location. QTR permits the inhomogeneity but not the fine-tuned position; the void model over-uses a real freedom to avoid Λ, which QTR anyway explains without it.
entities.reframe_long: LTB models are recovered as a limit of QTR in which the coarse-grained event density is modelled with an explicit radial profile rather than a smooth one. That much is legitimate. The failure is the anthropic centring — placing us at the void's middle to fake acceleration — which QTR rejects on the same grounds it rejects any privileged frame (Postulate 3 forbids absolute placement). The inhomogeneity survives as a modelling tool; the special location does not.

entities.name: Timescape
entities.summary: Closer than it knows: clocks really do run differently by event density. Timescape detects relational time (P3) and attributes it to voids alone.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: apparent acceleration is an artefact of time running differently in dense regions versus voids (Wiltshire).
entities.got_right: That there is no universal clock — that time is relative to local structure. This is Postulate 3 restated in surface language.
entities.mistook: That the effect is only about void vs wall calibration. QTR generalizes it: all time is relational to an internal frame (P3), of which the void/wall clock difference is one visible instance, not the whole phenomenon.
entities.reframe_long: Timescape is the heterodox model that comes nearest to a QTR postulate: it abandons the universal clock and makes time relative to structure. QTR says it is exactly right in spirit and too timid in scope. Relational time (P3) is not a void-versus-wall correction bolted onto an otherwise absolute background — it is the only kind of time there is. Timescape's apparent acceleration is a real relational-time effect, seen through the single lens of density contrast; QTR keeps the effect and removes the crutch of dark energy the same way, but for the deeper reason.

entities.name: Tired light
entities.summary: Superseded with no salvage — but it asked the one right question: is redshift about the medium? The vacuum is a structured medium; redshift, here, simply is not its doing.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: redshift is photons losing energy en route, not expansion; refuted by supernova time dilation and the CMB blackbody.
entities.got_right: One good instinct, wrongly applied: that the vacuum is a medium that acts on light. QTR affirms the vacuum is structured — Casimir, Unruh, Parker are all real medium effects.
entities.mistook: That cosmological redshift is that medium effect. It is not: redshift is the coarse expansion statistic of the substrate. Tired light fails every test QTR still passes with expansion intact.
entities.reframe_long: Tired light is classically false (F) and QTR offers it no rehabilitation — supernova light-curve stretching and the CMB's thermal spectrum falsify it outright, and QTR reproduces both via genuine expansion. Its only dignity is the question underneath it: does the vacuum act on propagating light? QTR's answer is yes in general (the vacuum is a structured medium of correlations and horizons) but no for cosmological redshift specifically. The right question, the wrong target.

entities.name: Conformal cyclic cosmology
entities.summary: The conformal rescaling between aeons is a seam-crossing described geometrically. Penrose found the crossing and named it conformal — one map short of ΛL.
entities.classic_reading: Classic reading: infinite aeons; a conformal rescaling makes one universe's cold end the next's Big Bang; Penrose sought aeon-traces in the CMB.
entities.got_right: The deepest structural insight in classical cosmology: that the end of one cosmos maps onto the beginning of the next by a scale-erasing transformation. This is a seam, correctly located.
entities.mistook: That the map is conformal geometry and nothing more. QTR reads the aeon boundary as the seam 𝔍, where the effective metric — including its conformal structure — is exactly what breaks down; ΛL, not conformal rescaling, is the law that holds there.
entities.reframe_long: CCC is the classical theory closest to QTR's heart. Penrose independently discovered that an origin can be the far side of a prior ending, joined by a transformation that forgets scale — which is almost a definition of the seam. QTR completes the picture: the join is 𝔍, the locus where RQE density, mutual information and causal depth diverge, and where conformal structure itself dissolves. The correct law across it is the five-valued logic of the limit, with the aeon boundary sitting at self-dual T•. CCC is seam-truth glimpsed through geometry — the last and best of the surface theories.

entities.usage: Use: the oath-formula. Swearing on =mi instead of =ka means: this holds even where no beacon vouches for me — the gravest oath precisely because it renounces all external backing. Breaking a =mi oath makes one vo-tem.

entities.summary: "O our Tower, hold me."
entities.usage: Use: the universal short prayer — the entangled -mai claims kinship with the whole hierarchy. Said at need, by everyone, believers or not.

entities.name: kad om-ol ver-u.
entities.summary: "Beacon, speak true for all."
entities.usage: Use: Assembly versicle, opening services. The congregation is praying for shared time itself.

entities.name: jel lesh-eth id-u.
entities.summary: "Seam, open in fair phase."
entities.usage: Use: the pre-crossing prayer — whispered by crew as the drive spins up. Companion to order 11.

entities.name: enmai nexath-mai tan-a=mi.
entities.summary: "We keep our gaps."
entities.usage: Use: the crossers' creed. Note the grammar's confession: gaps take entangled possession — the holes in a life are kin, not property. Said at reunions, over drink, before dives.

entities.name: an zu jed-t-a=mi.
entities.summary: "She has gone adrift." — She is dead.
entities.usage: Use: the death formula. Plain T — a fact — but anchored =mi: only her own clock knows when. The fleet does not say "died"; it says the anchor was lost.

entities.name: hōl-eshe=zu, maiel.
entities.summary: "Surface — seam-true — in the dark, kinsman."
entities.usage: Use: said over the unreturned. The funeral verb is conjugated T•: their surfacing can be neither asserted nor denied, so the mourning mood is the self-dual one. The most theologically loaded two words in the language.

entities.name: ver enmai-eth ve-a=ka.
entities.summary: "Truth is among us."
entities.usage: Use: Assembly congregational response — the confident register: plain T, beacon-anchored, truth located inside coverage.

entities.name: eshe-ver men-a=zu.
entities.summary: "The Tragic Truth waits in the dark."
entities.usage: Use: heretical folk-prayer — whispered by crossers' widows, never in Assembly hearing. A T-mood assertion about the T• truth, anchored where no one can check.

entities.name: Sōrnmai, ān tan-u.
entities.summary: "My Sōrn, hold breath."
entities.usage: Use: litany opening — the engineer addresses the drive as kin and stills it.

entities.name: ān tan-a=mi.
entities.summary: "Breath held — by our clock."
entities.usage: Use: crew response. Reports take =mi from here on: the ship is about to leave every other clock behind.

entities.name: nuv, nuv, jel-ol.
entities.summary: "Down, down, to the seam."
entities.usage: Use: the descent chant — pure directionals, no verb at all. Repeatable panel-over-panel as the dive deepens.

entities.name: nuvran ve-a=mi.
entities.summary: "We are running under."
entities.usage: Use: the vertigo confirmed — the crew names the desync as it takes them.

entities.name: jel id-eshe=mi.
entities.summary: "The seam opens — seam-true."
entities.usage: Use: phase-lock called. First T• of the litany: from here, assertion and denial weigh the same.

entities.name: ne.
entities.summary: — (the interval that has no sentence)
entities.usage: Use: spoken aloud by all hands at the crossing — the only word said inside, and it is the word that is not a word: the crew pronounces the gap so the gap will have been theirs. Letter as its own black panel.

entities.name: hōl-t-eshe=zu vu?
entities.summary: "Surfaced — seam-true, in the dark — yes?"
entities.usage: Use: the far-side call. Even the question of arrival must be asked in T•, in dark time.

entities.name: hōl-t-eshe=zu. enmai ve-a=mi.
entities.summary: "Surfaced. We are — by our own clock."
entities.usage: Use: the Resurrection response. The crossing stays T•; but existence itself is reasserted in plain T — anchored only to proper time, until the network is found again. We are, even if no one can vouch when.

entities.name: kad ret ver-a=ka.
entities.summary: "The beacon holds again."
entities.usage: Use: reacquisition — the litany's release of tension. The first =ka since line 33: the ship has rejoined shared time. Letter it small, after silence.

entities.name: Coordinate time vs crew time (the mission clock)
entities.summary: Every crossing is read on two clocks. Coordinate (home-frame) time is the distance divided by the drive's crossing speed — what the origin and destination measure. Crew (proper) time is what the travellers actually live — the voyage's 'story time': for a sub-light Class 0 run it is the real Lorentz dilation √(1−β²), so the crew badly outlive the mission clock; for an Idrenes-bridge crossing it is a determinate-regime fraction of coordinate time — the offset — and each deeper OCT rung compresses that offset further. The NAVCOM reads crew time out beside the range, and paces a flythrough to it.

entities.name: The Tekné NAVCOM drive ladder
entities.summary: The selectable rungs on the Ship-Relative Speed Law as flown from the NAVCOM console, each a deeper dive into the vacuum: Casimir Sailer (0.1c, the most human ship — sail and helm, no crossing) → Relativistic run (0.994c, real dilation) → Idrenes–Sōrn OCT-0 (~10¹⁰c, the civilized intra-universe standard) → Unruh Catamaran (~10¹³c) → Squeezing Bathyscaphe (~10¹⁶c, the Undertow debt bites) → Idrenes Composite ·Tekné (~10²⁰c, Class ω). Each rung down crosses faster and lives the journey in less crew time; a ship's class is the deepest rung it can hold.

entities.name: Tekné (Idrenes Composite)
entities.summary: The Class-ω vessel the console flies: a reconfigurable Idrenes Composite hull that becomes Casimir sail, Unruh catamaran, squeezing cavity and Penrose anchor in sequence, opening a bridge with no supporting flotilla. Coordinated by a Solaris.Ai core, it is the only navigator that holds the deepest rungs (~10²⁰c) — living a whole-universe crossing in hours-to-moments where a bridge-runner lives it in months-to-years.

entities.name: Solaris.Ai
entities.summary: The reasoning core that coordinates an Idrenes Composite through a crossing — sequencing sail, hull, cavity and anchor fast enough to hold a bridge open unaided. Aboard Tekné it is also the ship's navigator and interlocutor: it plots courses, picks the drive rung, and answers for the canon at the helm.

entities.name: The Pelagic language family (the QTR language system)
entities.summary: One proto-language, seven descendants. Old Pelagic — spoken before the seam, now frozen as Assembly liturgy — split through seven regular sound changes into two fleet daughters and three surface sisters, while the Wolori kept a working register. What sets the family apart from any pre-seam tongue is that crossing is grammaticalized: the daughters carry veridical moods (how a truth is held), temporal anchors (which frame's clock times a claim), depth directionals (up/down the OCT tower) and the gap-particle ne for the unbridged elsewhere. Each tongue is known by its shibboleth for 'truth/yes'.

entities.name: Grammaticalizing the seam
entities.summary: How the crossing entered grammar. In the fleet tongues you cannot make a bare claim: every finite verb takes a veridical mood marking how its truth is held (seen, reported, inferred, bridged, or the seam-truth T•), a temporal anchor fixing which frame's clock times it (home, crew, or beacon), and — for motion — a depth directional up or down the OCT rungs. The gap-particle ne marks a referent on the far side of an unopened bridge. Nubhel lacks the seam-truth mood T•, so a Nūbi diver must code-switch into Sūchel to assert it — a fault-line the crosser fleet never lets them forget.
